idea: Mistakes: tracking workouts in the notes app
caption: the notes app was never built for this

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 4 mistakes people make tracking workouts in their notes app

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text:
1. a new note every session.
a month later you can't find anything.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
2. numbers with no exercise names.
example: "100 7 6" means nothing in three weeks.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text:
3. writing it up at home.
you'll round, guess, or skip it.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
4. no target before the set.
so you just repeat last week.
EARND keeps each exercise's last session beside today's target. nothing to scroll for.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
one place for every set.
EARND launches soon. Follow for the launch.
